scope: Offline P8u Base research canonical only. This is not an inference, admission, execution, or exchange-writing configuration.

selection.name: P8U_RAW_BPS_CATBOOST_QUERYRMSE_F72_TAIL125
selection.supersedes: P8u policy-ordinal LightGBM Base control for future P8u Base research

route.rule: exact timestamp-local top 50 percent identity gate

base_model.query: exact decision timestamp x long side
base_model.target: canonical rich-policy net bps, clipped then ordinalised into six equal-width classes
base_model.note_on_gain: CatBoost QueryRMSE consumes the six ordinal labels directly; the G3 tag records the parent target-search lineage, not a CatBoost label_gain parameter.

weights.rule: row weights are renormalised to mean one within each timestamp query

fit.held_scores: persisted target-free before any policy outcome join

selected_downstream_research_contract.current_family: 0.75 * Base timestamp rank + 0.25 * strict-OOF Under F120 under_bps100 timestamp rank
selected_downstream_research_contract.meta_authority: Under F120 / under_bps100 timestamp Rank-XENDCG only; magnitude, adverse-path, signed-State, and multi-head alternatives were rejected by their matched strict-prequential diagnostics
selected_downstream_research_contract.mc1: separate strict-prequential three-month Current and BCF maps
selected_downstream_research_contract.admission: Current MC1 expected net >= +50 bps AND BCF MC1 expected net >= +50 bps
selected_downstream_research_contract.portfolio: one chronological constrained auction, BCF MC1 expected net priority

required_before_live_promotion: at least six common post-Meta months under this exact dual-family construction
